tw: For sport, Kron jumps short of the port and lands on a fort of shorts.
twc: 为了运动，Kron 跳没跳到码头，落在一座短裤堆成的城堡上。
hint: 跳远没跳到，落地很英雄。

tw: On his walk, Kron stops to talk to a hawk eating chalk.
twc: Kron 散步时停下来，跟一只正在吃粉笔的老鹰聊天。
hint: 散步散一半，被吃粉笔的鹰吸走。

tw: In Kron's community, cute unicorns play music, knit, and come for tea.
twc: Kron 的社区里，可爱的独角兽们弹琴、织毛衣、来喝茶。

tw: Kron saves his favourite flavour in a cave, and a whale waves for it.
twc: Kron 把最爱的口味藏在山洞里，一头鲸鱼挥鳍要吃。

tw: Kron races to his place in space, but a cat ate his plate of cake.
twc: Kron 飞奔到太空里自己的位置，结果猫把他那盘蛋糕吃了。
hint: 抢到了位置，没抢到蛋糕。

tw: Kron takes a photo of a goat in a coat posing on its toe.
twc: Kron 给一只穿大衣、踮着一只脚摆姿势的山羊拍照。

tw: Kron's story is so boring, four horses snore on the floor.
twc: Kron 讲的故事太无聊，四匹马躺在地上打呼噜。

tw: Kron buys a pie as high as the sky, and a fly says hi.
twc: Kron 买了一个高到天上的馅饼，一只苍蝇在顶上打招呼。

tw: Firefighter Kron fires a mighty water hose at one tiny candle fire.
twc: 消防员 Kron 用一根超大水枪喷向一根小小的蜡烛火苗。

tw: "Why?" cries Kron, as five white mice fly by on a kite.
twc: “为什么？”Kron 喊道，五只小白鼠坐着风筝飞过。

tw: Kron shivers in the river, so a fish gives him its little slippers.
twc: Kron 在河里冻得发抖，一条鱼把自己的小拖鞋送给他。

tw: In his tent, Kron gives an ant an important order: four more pork pies!
twc: Kron 在帐篷里给蚂蚁下了道重要命令：再来四个猪肉派！

tw: Cleaner Kron cleans the queen's green jeans until the green is gone.
twc: 清洁工 Kron 给女王洗绿色牛仔裤，洗到绿色都没了。
hint: 洗得太干净，颜色也洗掉。

tw: Kron makes a delivery to Liv the lizard: a very big silver mirror.
twc: Kron 给蜥蜴小莉送快递：一面特别大的银镜子。
hint: 快递一到，蜥蜴爱上自己。

tw: "Please!" says Police Kron to the geese. "Give back my piece of cheese!"
twc: “求求你们！”警察 Kron 对鹅说，“把我那块奶酪还给我！”
hint: 警察来抓鹅，鹅抢了警察。

tw: Kron carries a lot of hot pots, then trips and drops the lot.
twc: Kron 端着一大摞热锅，绊了一跤，全掉了。

tw: "Now!" shouts Kron, and a fat brown owl sits down on his round head.
twc: Kron 喊“就现在！”，一只胖胖的棕色猫头鹰坐到他的圆脑袋上。
hint: 喊了“现在”，猫头鹰现在就到。

tw: Kron goes to make the bed, but the big red bear makes Kron the bed.
twc: Kron 去铺床，结果大红熊把 Kron 当成了床。

tw: Kron tells ten yellow shells a secret, and they yell it to the sea.
twc: Kron 把秘密告诉十个黄贝壳，贝壳冲着大海喊了出来。
hint: 秘密告诉贝壳，全海都知道。

tw: Everyone gets seven little eggs, but Kron gets one very heavy egg.
twc: 大家都拿到七个小蛋，Kron 却拿到一个特别重的大蛋。
hint: 大家分小蛋，他分到巨蛋。
